title: Severe pulmonary arterial hypertension in congenital sideroblastic anemia from PUS1 mutation - a case report.
authors: Kothari SS, Shah J, Sharma V, Charaniya R, Parikh R, Vaniawala SN.
figures: a : Sanger sequencing (electrophoregram)showing the homozygous nucleotide change C > T at c.430 in PUS1 gene. The variation was confirmed by sequencing with both forward and reverse primers.  b : Coronal CT image (lung window) showing dilated pulmonary arteries and mosaic attenuation with tiny cysts in the periphery.  c  - T1 myocardial map sagittal oblique image depicting the decrease T1 value
